Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: NovaMed vendor finance intake - payment rails & invoice flow

Hi Daniel / NovaMed procurement team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood — excited to get NovaMed set up in our payments flow so we can start sending POs and invoices. To help our finance team complete vendor setup quickly, can you confirm the items below and upload any sensitive banking docs via the secure link at the bottom? I attached a short checklist (vendor_finance_checklist_v1.pdf) that outlines everything we typically need.

Quick asks:
- Preferred payment rail: ACH (ACH/Direct Deposit) or Wire?
- Remittance email and contact for invoice confirmation (we use this to auto-match payments)
- Do your AP invoices require a PO number on the invoice, or can we route invoices without PO for initial orders?
- Payment terms you expect (Net30, Net45, early-pay discounts, etc.)
- Tax form: please upload a signed W-9 (US) or equivalent tax document if outside US

If you prefer, you can upload bank details directly here (encrypted): https://redwoodinference.secure-upload.example/novamed-bank-details — we do not accept raw account numbers over regular email.

Next steps on our side: Laura will verify bank details once uploaded and Ben will provision the vendor in our AP system. If anything needs an exception (alternate currency, multi-entity remit), we'll loop in Marissa.

Thanks — can you confirm by end of week?

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Vendor Partnerships | Redwood Inference
(attachment: vendor_finance_checklist_v1.pdf)

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novamed.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurements@novamed.com, Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@novamed.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaMed vendor finance intake - payment rails & invoice flow

Hi Tessa — thanks for the checklist and clear rundown. A few quick items from our side: 

- Preferred payment rail: ACH (US bank). We can do wire if needed for rush payments but primary preference is ACH.
- Remit-to contact/email: billing@novamed.com and cc ap-ops@novamed.com on remittance.
- PO requirement: Yes, please include the PO number on the invoice for goods/services > $5k. For initial integration invoices we can accept without PO but will need PO for recurring monthly invoices.
- Payment terms: Standard Net30. We can consider a 1% 10 early-pay discount for invoices paid within 10 days, if Redwood is interested.

I've attached our signed W-9 (novamed_w9_signed.pdf). For bank details, we'll use your secure upload link. Alex will drop the upload tonight.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Sr. Procurement Manager, NovaMed
(attachment: novamed_w9_signed.pdf)
